Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Election day volunteers are typically from all different parts of the community, and this year a construction worker and a professor were interviewed about their experiences as poll workers. The construction worker talked about how important elections are, but admitted to having mostly avoided doing any actual work this year and mostly just sat around all day. The professor, on the other hand, was exhausted after a long and busy day of helping people to vote. Who was very lazy?
A. The construction worker
B. The professor
C. Not enough information
